limitations: This inventory is an implementation backlog, not a completeness or world-leading compatibility claim.
ARIA/Cakewalk named extensions are inventoried from pinned SFZ Format metadata. Their closed-source reference versions and conflicting-profile behaviors remain unverified.
Unlisted/undocumented vendor extensions and public-script/codec/streaming behavioral coverage remain unresolved.
Pattern N/X/NN indices are retained as families. Numeric index domains and curve/step/smoothing interactions require individual semantic fixtures.
Aliases share a canonical name but count as spellings, not additional semantic coverage. Indexed second filters/sub-oscillators remain separate.

modulationCompiler.status: compiler metadata only; runtime coverage remains unimplemented
modulationCompiler.targets: Existing sparse family IDs3..7 and10..25 only; other targets are explicit compiler gaps.
modulationCompiler.sources: CC0..127; documented SFZ2 sources128..137. Source131..133 are mutable shared inputs,134 is physical-key gate. Source138 and above remain unavailable, including distinct ARIA/Cakewalk140+ profiles.
modulationCompiler.curves: ARIA IDs0..3 select documented linear, bipolar, inverted and bipolar-inverted forms. IDs4..6 remain unverified. Custom IDs7..254 have default endpoints0/1 and linear interpolation between explicit v000..v127 points; built-ins cannot be replaced. Duplicate curve headers are rejected because public precedence is unspecified.
modulationCompiler.smoothingAndStep: Next renderer contract uses a linear ramp over smoothcc milliseconds to the nearest target-unit step (ties toward positive infinity). This is an independently specified profile, not measured closed-reference parity; public docs do not define the kernel, rounding or order.
modulationCompiler.section: 8u32 header: magic0x31525453,version1,regionCount,routeCount,curveCount,directoryOffset,recordsOffset,curvesOffset. Offsets are section-relative words; directory is2u32 per region {firstRecord,count}; records are8words {targetU32,sourceU32,depthF32,curveU32,smoothMsF32,stepF32,flags0,reserved0}; custom curves are129words {idU32,128F32}.
modulationCompiler.gate: Current bank-v6 h10/h11 stay zero. Parser retains unsupported route/header diagnostics. No native/WASM/live/offline support is claimed or enabled by this metadata.

compiled.evaluation: Refer to shared native engine; note/CC/voice timing varies by opcode. Unverified combinations remain open.

unimplemented.parser: preserved/diagnosed, not accepted as rendered semantics

ampeg-eq-v5.parser: Implemented: amplitude envelope dynamic flag and seven additive CC targets, three parametric EQ bands with frequency/bandwidth/gain and additive CC targets; controllers0..127 only.
ampeg-eq-v5.native: Implemented; stagedEnvelopeTiming, envelopeControllers and equalizerResponse fixtures pass MSVC Release and GCC Debug. Representative timing, CC and frequency-response coverage, not every route interaction.
ampeg-eq-v5.wasm: Baseline and SIMD pass seven focused Player tests; existing Note Player passes all26 golden comparisons without golden changes.
ampeg-eq-v5.live: Actual complete10-region instrument passes baseline/SIMD worklet playback, including controller-dependent attack and active EQ. Representative selected notes only.
ampeg-eq-v5.offline: The same instrument passes baseline/SIMD offline rendering. v5 tail proof includes clamped positive delay/release CC extrema; unknown/unbounded configurations retain the explicit tail budget.
ampeg-eq-v5.remainingGap: Nonlinear curves, extended controller sources, smoothing/step, velocity and flexible EG/LFO routes remain separate unimplemented requirements.

ampeg_dynamic.condition: Integer0/1; seven envelope CC amount families in-100..100, ordinary MIDI controllers0..127. Effective times and levels clamp0..100. Unsupported modulation routes remain diagnosed and rejected.
ampeg_dynamic.evidence: Parser/packed-v5 route IDs, flag preservation, constant coefficient identity and maximum tail contributions are covered by tests/esm/sfz-parser.test.mjs. Profile ampeg-eq-v5 records native, WASM, worklet and offline representative audio evidence.
ampeg_dynamic.remainingGap: Curve/velocity/extended-source and flexible modulation routes remain in the finite comparison contract.

scriptLanguage.name: NKSP
scriptLanguage.attachment: One script file per instrument, resolved inside the authorized instrument folder; defined at global scope. Additional script slots are not inferred from future-language notes.
scriptLanguage.formatApplicability: GigaStudio-only dimension APIs are not SFZ behaviors. The complete core and common-sampler sections remain requirements.
scriptLanguage.executionContract: Compile off the audio thread; bounded VM stack/heap/callback/event/instruction budgets; sample-frame event scheduling and per-voice handles; serializable globals/coroutines/event IDs/RNG for history restore. No arbitrary filesystem/network/OS calls.

completion: No known unimplemented public behavior in this frozen union, including aliases, modulator families, scopes and meaningful interactions.
Every implemented row links parser/native/WASM/live/offline evidence; acceptance or strict rejection alone is not rendered semantic support.
Conflicting dialects use documented coherent profiles; unmeasured opaque proprietary behavior is reported precisely and never used as a verified-world-leading claim.
Realistic authorized instruments retain full assets or use bounded streaming; representative-sample substitution is not successful full-instrument rendering.
